title: Social cut-downs with optional face tracking
what_it_does: Reframes any MP4 to 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5 in blur, crop (with focus per segment), pad or face-tracking mode, and cuts to one or more time ranges. Warns that blur/pad shrink burned captions and offers --zoom.
when_to_use: Vertical versions of talking-head footage where the speaker must stay in frame.
why: Overlaps the ffmpeg-skill reframe, but the face-tracking mode and the honest note about caption size in 9:16 are worth having.
